plate.purpose: Object names only: the atlas-plate target label, example targets, the title-screen name.

headline.purpose: Panel and dialog headings, state-card heads.

hint.purpose: Explanatory hints, option rows, segmented controls.

figure.purpose: Every coordinate, date, flux and count, in tabular figures.

detectors.purpose: Wavelength-ordered key for interface marks only (timeline ticks, detector checklist); never applied to images.

overlays.purpose: Catalogue and reference marks drawn on the sky views.

invertedSky.purpose: Deeper variants used when the sky is shown inverted (white).

shadows.name: dialog-lift
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs, over a rgba(5, 9, 17, .72) backdrop.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Border, background and colour transitions on controls; chevron rotation.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Dialog rise, bottom-sheet slide, title-screen exit, progress line.

components.name: Header Tabs

components.description: Hairline-divided measurement row with a mono summary and a thin chevron.

components.name: Stage Readout
components.description: The single corner readout on the black stage: scale bar and orientation.
components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; width: 320px; height: 160px; background: #000; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-readout { position: absolute; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; text-align: right; font: 0.75rem/1.35 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; color: #e9eef5; background: #0a1220; border: 1px solid #22314a; border-radius: 4px; padding: 5px 9px; } .ds-scale { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-scale i { display: block; width: 72px; height: 6px; border: 1.5px solid #e9eef5; border-top: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a printed star-atlas plate read under a red night-vision torch. The sky image owns the screen; everything else is quiet chart furniture: a chart-navy ground in one fixed tonal ramp, chalk text, 1px hairline rules, and a single night-vision red that marks only what you can act on, the current selection, and the target. The target is labelled the way an atlas labels a plate: its name in an italic serif, its coordinates in tabular mono beneath.

Density is working-instrument density. Panels are flat and separated from the ground by hairlines, never boxed or carded; settings sit behind a labelled icon rail, measurements in one right-hand column, and the only scrolling regions are the side panels. Type is small and sentence case throughout, with numbers always in tabular mono so columns of coordinates and fluxes align.

Science images are shown exactly as the backend renders them: neutral grey ramp, no tint, no filter, no blend mode, on a plain black stage. The system styles the furniture around the pixels and never the pixels. It rejects the category default of a glowing neon HUD console with boxed panels on every side.
keyCharacteristics: One tonal ramp of chart navy (ink-0 to ink-5) carries every surface, rule and hover.
One accent, night-vision red, reserved for primary actions, the current selection and the target ring.
Amber means a flag or warning and nothing else.
Italic serif for object names only; Public Sans for the interface; JetBrains Mono tabular figures for every number.
Hairlines, not boxes; flat panels, shadows only on things that float.
Untinted science imagery on a black stage.

rules.name: The Torch Rule
rules.body: Red marks only what you can act on, the current selection and the target. Never use it for decoration, headings, status or data series.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every surface, rule and hover state is a step on the ink ramp. A new surface picks an existing step; it does not mix a new navy.

rules.name: The Untinted Sky Rule
rules.body: Nothing in the system touches science-image pixels: no tint, filter, blend mode or colour overlay. Marks are drawn on top as thin strokes; readouts sit in one corner.

rules.name: The Named-Object Rule
rules.body: The italic serif is for the names of celestial objects (and the product name on the title screen). It never sets interface labels, headings or numbers.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every coordinate, date, flux and count is set in the mono with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Interface text is sentence case at normal tracking. Labels are not uppercased or letterspaced, and nothing is labelled twice.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px Hairline rules. Panels are not boxed, carded or shadowed; if it does not float, it has no shadow.

dos: Do keep red to primary actions, the current selection and the target ring (The Torch Rule).
Do take every surface and rule from the ink ramp, ink-0 to ink-5.
Do show science images untinted on the black stage, with marks drawn on top as 1.5px strokes.
Do set object names in Source Serif 4 italic and every number in JetBrains Mono tabular figures.
Do separate panels with 1px Hairline rules and keep them flat.
Do use amber only for flags and warnings.
Do honour reduced motion: dialogs stop rising and transitions drop to zero.
donts: Don't tint, filter, blend or recolour science-image pixels.
Don't build a glowing neon HUD: no glows, no boxed or carded panels on every side.
Don't use red for decoration, headings, status or a data series.
Don't put shadows on anything that does not float above the workspace.
Don't uppercase or letterspace interface labels, or label the same thing twice.
Don't use the serif italic for interface text.
